JustWatch ur yesɛi adellel neɣ SDK n tesleḍt, ur yesɛi aqeddac n uvidyu n umsneflay. Iseɣwan ttwasqedcen deg usawal-nnek. Tansayin n uvidyu, Cloudflare DNS d GitHub ttawin isutren d tansa IP-nnek. Asnas isenqad ileqqman mi t-teldiḍ, tikkelt deg wass ma aṭas. Kečč ad tebduḍ asader, sakin ad tesirgeḍ asbedd deg Android. Asnas yettaɛraḍ ad yekkes ividyuten imezgan. Isɣewwaren, asenqed d ifuyla n umsekkar qqimen deg usawal. Asebter web yezmer ad iḥerrez cookies d isefka n usmel. Kkes isefka n usnas i tukksa n uḥraz adigan. Nermes Amine-AO s GitHub. Isutren d izuyaz: ur d-tsuffeɣ isefka udmawanen.
Wagi d agzul. Tasertit taččurant n tbaḍnit tella tura s Taglizit.
